record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.kind: fight-start random item (no PassiveEffects entry; checked inside Simulation.applyItemsEffects)
record.summary: Passive.PICKUP has NO entry in PassiveEffects (routing uncertainty NO_PASSIVE_EFFECTS_ENTRY); its only caller is Simulation.applyItemsEffects, and the name PICKUP is shared with the separate ability Ability.PICKUP (NAME_SHARED_WITH_ABILITY, used by other units such as Persian forms; not covered here). ZIGZAGOON (1 star) and LINOONE (2 stars) are WILD + FIELD, maxPP 50, range 1, skill SLASH. When the unit's fight entity is added to the simulation (Simulation.addPokemon) and its item set is empty, one item is picked uniformly at random from the craftable non-scarf items plus the 20 non-special berries and added to the ENTITY's item set; then every held item (including the pick) goes through applyItemEffect, so its declared stats and item effects apply as if the unit had been given the item. The pick happens only if the entity holds no item at that moment, so a unit holding any item gets nothing. The picked item is added to the fight entity only: the board pokemon's item set (copied into the entity in the constructor) is not changed by this code, so it does not persist after the fight in the code read. A second application also runs on a battle-start clone (PokemonEntity at lines 1441-1450), with its own independent random pick. Stat effects of the picked item are applied through the usual stat helpers (core-mechanics.md section I); which item is received is random and no specific outcome is claimed. No gameplay claims.
triggers: called from Simulation.addPokemon and from the battle-start reference clone

effects.declaredRaw: one item chosen uniformly from CraftableItemsNoScarves concatenated with NonSpecialBerries
effects.scaling: none; no AP, level or star scaling
effects.resolution: requested: one item. Applied: added to the entity item set only if items.size === 0 at that time (the size check is for any item, not just craftable ones); pool excludes scarves, synergy-special berries (NANAB, GOLDEN_RAZZ, GOLDEN_NANAB, GOLDEN_PINAP) and non-craftable items; the size of the craftable pool was not counted here. Because the pick is an item on the entity, its ItemStats and ItemEffects are applied immediately afterwards by the same function

effects.declaredRaw: ItemStats and ItemEffects of the picked item
effects.scaling: declared item stats pass through applyStat and the stat helpers (Big Eater Belt / Twist Band etc. where they hold) with apBoost 0; core-mechanics.md section I
effects.resolution: declared amounts are requested; applied amounts depend on the item and helper; not enumerated per item here (see lookup-item for any single item)

effects.resolution: the picked item is added to the entity set, not to the board pokemon; the clone recomputation (lines 1441-1450) builds a new entity from the board pokemon, so it makes its own random pick
